title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the wavelength as a function of angle and parameters.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must clearly state that no radiation is emitted with a transmission grating.

title: Explanation of Frequency Dependence
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the frequency of emitted radiation varies with the angle and velocity.

title: Understanding of Bremsstrahlung
description: Important Criteria: The student must discuss the concept of bremsstrahlung and its relevance to metallic versus transmission gratings.

title: Clarity of Reasoning
description: Optional Criteria: The response should be logically structured and easy to follow.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign errors in the expression for wavelength or frequency.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations.
